title: Legacy of Seergaze

overview.startPoint: Talk to the mercenary adventurer east of Paterdomus in Morytania.
otherReqs: Partial completion of Shades of Mort'ton (to make teak pyre logs)

blocks.html: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer at the Temple Trekking ending point (west of Canifis). CKS or the Canifis lodestone are good options to reach the area quickly.
blocks.text: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer at the Temple Trekking ending point (west of Canifis). CKS or the Canifis lodestone are good options to reach the area quickly.

blocks.html: Enter the Mausoleum west of the Adventurer.
blocks.text: Enter the Mausoleum west of the Adventurer.

blocks.html: Talk to Drezel.
blocks.text: Talk to Drezel.

options.text: Who do you think these suspicious people are?

blocks.html: Go through the gate west of Drezel and climb down the stairs north of the well.
blocks.text: Go through the gate west of Drezel and climb down the stairs north of the well.

blocks.html: Search the sparkling wall storage unit a few steps east of the stairs, then go back up the stairs.
blocks.text: Search the sparkling wall storage unit a few steps east of the stairs, then go back up the stairs.

blocks.html: Exit the Mausoleum via the west entrance ladder, enter the Paterdomus temple and head to the top floor.
blocks.text: Exit the Mausoleum via the west entrance ladder, enter the Paterdomus temple and head to the top floor.

blocks.html: After the cutscene, kill Fistandantilus and Zaromark Sliver (or wait until they time out and teleport away).
blocks.text: After the cutscene, kill Fistandantilus and Zaromark Sliver (or wait until they time out and teleport away).

substeps.html: Both enemies have 2,750 life points, a combat level of 77, and a max hit of 220 in magic and ranged. These enemies will use prayer to become immune to your combat style, but do not protect against necromancy. Necromancy or multiple combat styles are recommended for this fight.
substeps.text: Both enemies have 2,750 life points, a combat level of 77, and a max hit of 220 in magic and ranged. These enemies will use prayer to become immune to your combat style, but do not protect against necromancy. Necromancy or multiple combat styles are recommended for this fight.

blocks.html: Search the crude table in the north-west corner of the room.
blocks.text: Search the crude table in the north-west corner of the room.

blocks.html: Return to Drezel.
blocks.text: Return to Drezel.

options.text: Do you think this has anything to do with the Guthixian Edicts?

blocks.html: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer and escort him the same way as any Burgh de Rott Ramble.
blocks.text: Talk to the Mercenary Adventurer and escort him the same way as any Burgh de Rott Ramble.

options.text: You still want to go to Burgh de Rott?
I can take you to Burgh de Rott.

substeps.html: Easy path recommended for least time and effort. Be sure to remove any melee-reducing equipment like ranged and magic armour. If you encounter juvinates, you will require your Rod of Ivandis or another silver weapon.
substeps.text: Easy path recommended for least time and effort. Be sure to remove any melee-reducing equipment like ranged and magic armour. If you encounter juvinates, you will require your Rod of Ivandis or another silver weapon.

blocks.html: Once in Burgh de Rott, if the dialogue does not automatically start, talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.
blocks.text: Once in Burgh de Rott, if the dialogue does not automatically start, talk to the Mercenary Adventurer.

substeps.html: If no one with that name is present in Burgh de Rott, skip to the next step.
substeps.text: If no one with that name is present in Burgh de Rott, skip to the next step.

blocks.html: Climb over the wall inside the Pub and then climb down the trapdoor to the cellar.
blocks.text: Climb over the wall inside the Pub and then climb down the trapdoor to the cellar.

blocks.html: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz until he gives you a crate.
blocks.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz until he gives you a crate.

options.text: Do you have a job for me?

blocks.html: Climb up the ladder.
blocks.text: Climb up the ladder.

blocks.html: Go south of Burgh de Rott and take the boat to Meiyerditch.
blocks.text: Go south of Burgh de Rott and take the boat to Meiyerditch.

blocks.html: Go to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. Refer to the Meiyerditch shortcut guide for help. Being caught by the vyrewatch and sent to mines provides a fast and reliable route.
blocks.text: Go to the Meiyerditch Myreque base. Refer to the Meiyerditch shortcut guide for help. Being caught by the vyrewatch and sent to mines provides a fast and reliable route.

blocks.html: Talk to Flaygian Screwte, in the north room, and offer him your help.
blocks.text: Talk to Flaygian Screwte, in the north room, and offer him your help.

options.text: Can I help in some way?

blocks.html: Ask Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw in the same room about weapons.
blocks.text: Ask Andiess Juip or Kael Forshaw in the same room about weapons.

options.text: Hi there, I was wondering if I could ask some questions?

blocks.html: Go to the next room south (near Mekritus A'hara) and search the middle bunk bed on the eastern half of the north wall for a book.
blocks.text: Go to the next room south (near Mekritus A'hara) and search the middle bunk bed on the eastern half of the north wall for a book.

blocks.html: Read it and remember which page mentioned flails.
blocks.text: Read it and remember which page mentioned flails.

blocks.html: Give the book to Flaygian, giving him the proper page number. He will give you 10 nails and a hammer. (You can drop the hammer)
blocks.text: Give the book to Flaygian, giving him the proper page number. He will give you 10 nails and a hammer. (You can drop the hammer)

blocks.html: Head to the northernmost part of Meiyerditch and enter the house south of the house with the furnace ("mass of debris").
blocks.text: Head to the northernmost part of Meiyerditch and enter the house south of the house with the furnace ("mass of debris").

blocks.html: Use the Make-ladder option on the centre post.
blocks.text: Use the Make-ladder option on the centre post.

blocks.html: Climb up the post.
blocks.text: Climb up the post.

blocks.html: Jump across the floorboards to the east, then to the north.
blocks.text: Jump across the floorboards to the east, then to the north.

blocks.html: Jump west through the damaged wall.
blocks.text: Jump west through the damaged wall.

blocks.html: Climb up the ladder and search the trough.
blocks.text: Climb up the ladder and search the trough.

blocks.html: Take a piece of coal from the coal barrel.
blocks.text: Take a piece of coal from the coal barrel.

blocks.html: Go to the bottom floor and select "dig" on the mass of debris (right click).
blocks.text: Go to the bottom floor and select "dig" on the mass of debris (right click).

substeps.html: If the "dig" option doesn't appear, you must go back to the top floor and search the trough
substeps.text: If the "dig" option doesn't appear, you must go back to the top floor and search the trough

blocks.html: Use the coal on the furnace, then light the furnace.
blocks.text: Use the coal on the furnace, then light the furnace.

blocks.html: Return and talk to Flaygian, then in the same room;
blocks.text: Return and talk to Flaygian, then in the same room;

substeps.html: Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.
substeps.text: Take 2 silver and 2 mithril bars from the barrel on the northern wall.

substeps.html: Take a blessed sickle from the shelf on the south-western wall.
substeps.text: Take a blessed sickle from the shelf on the south-western wall.

blocks.html: Go to the room to the east of the entrance ladder.
blocks.text: Go to the room to the east of the entrance ladder.

blocks.html: Search the crate for a chain link mould and add it to your tool belt.
blocks.text: Search the crate for a chain link mould and add it to your tool belt.

blocks.html: Return to the furnace and make the Silvthril chain. It can be found by clicking on the silver bar in the smithing interface (scroll with down arrow next to "Casting Metals & Glass").
blocks.text: Return to the furnace and make the Silvthril chain. It can be found by clicking on the silver bar in the smithing interface (scroll with down arrow next to "Casting Metals & Glass").

substeps.html: You do not need to make 2, you will have 1 bar of each type left. These are not used at any point in the quest so you can safely deposit them into your metal bank.
substeps.text: You do not need to make 2, you will have 1 bar of each type left. These are not used at any point in the quest so you can safely deposit them into your metal bank.

blocks.html: Talk to Flaygian, then use the blessed sickle on him.
blocks.text: Talk to Flaygian, then use the blessed sickle on him.

options.text: How about using this as the head for the flail?

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan.

blocks.html: Proceed to the laboratory; the building south-east of the furnace, third from the top on the east wall and through the slashed tapestry.
blocks.text: Proceed to the laboratory; the building south-east of the furnace, third from the top on the east wall and through the slashed tapestry.

blocks.html: Dismiss any followers and climb down the stairs.
blocks.text: Dismiss any followers and climb down the stairs.

blocks.html: After the cutscene, Look at one of the bodies in the north-west corner.
blocks.text: After the cutscene, Look at one of the bodies in the north-west corner.

options.text: Is there anything I can do?

blocks.html: Search the door to the south and use the saw in your tool belt.
blocks.text: Search the door to the south and use the saw in your tool belt.

blocks.html: Climb-through the door, then after the cutscene continue down the long and winding tunnel.
blocks.text: Climb-through the door, then after the cutscene continue down the long and winding tunnel.

blocks.html: Continue north on the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.
blocks.text: Continue north on the path to the large chamber where the strange stones are.

blocks.html: If you need runes for the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, search the corpse next to the rocks before continuing.
blocks.text: If you need runes for the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, search the corpse next to the rocks before continuing.

substeps.html: Searching the corpse will complete the Bloodstained Treasure achievement, if not already completed.
substeps.text: Searching the corpse will complete the Bloodstained Treasure achievement, if not already completed.

blocks.html: Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.
blocks.text: Search the strange stones in the northern part of the cavern.

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan. There will be a cutscene and a fight against vyrewatches in which you cannot deal any damage, but the fight will end in another cutscene with Safalaan being attacked.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan. There will be a cutscene and a fight against vyrewatches in which you cannot deal any damage, but the fight will end in another cutscene with Safalaan being attacked.

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan.

blocks.html: Go to the surface, equip the Ivandis flail, kill a vyrewatch, and pick up its corpse.
blocks.text: Go to the surface, equip the Ivandis flail, kill a vyrewatch, and pick up its corpse.

blocks.text: Return to Safalaan.
